name: Epack Prefab Technologies Ltd
title: Epack Prefab Technologies Ltd - 544540 - Announcement under Regulation 30 (LODR)-Earnings Call Transcript

read.thesis: Capacity rising from 147k to ~220k MT by FY27-end with order book ~INR1,100-1,127 cr and 30% FY27 growth guided; Q4 utilisation 83% but sandwich panel line ran ~25% and margins fell 70-80 bps on steel costs.

utilisation.quote: in the last quarter we have hit a capacity utilization of 83%

capex.quote: we plan to do a total capex of close to INR150 crores in this financial year to ramp up our capacities

triggers.label: Capacity ~147k → ~220k MT by FY27-end
triggers.quote: end of FY27, we should have a capacity of close to 2,20,000 metric ton in PEB space

triggers.label: Sandwich panel line utilisation ~25%
triggers.quote: The capacity utilization was low at around 25%

triggers.label: Margin down 70-80 bps on steel
triggers.quote: The margin reduction by 70-80 basis point in the quarter four was mainly due to the steel price increment

triggers.label: Price increase from 80%+ of contracts
triggers.quote: In 80% plus of the contracts we have been able to get the price increase

guidance.quote: we are targeting a growth of 30% in our Prefab division
FY27 also our guidance is the same, it will be at least 10% plus throughout the year
the order book target for us in this year is INR2,000 crores plus
we plan to do a total capex of close to INR150 crores in this financial year
Going forward we see this going down by about 20-25 basis point in the year FY27

red_flags.label: Sandwich panel line at ~25% utilisation
red_flags.quote: The capacity utilization was low at around 25%

red_flags.label: Pass-through not 100%
red_flags.quote: Not 100%, but yes, we have been discussing with the customers

evasions.topic: Sandwich panel and PEB revenue split / margin by product
evasions.quote: we do not want to maintain it separately as well because most of the projects are integrated
Giving the, like run rate or average run rate per month and guiding towards it is difficult in a project business

evasions.topic: Pipeline conversion vs INR2,000 cr target
